purpose: Integrated Predictive and Funded portfolio economic evaluation across asset/regime/activity timeframes and shared EUR200 cash, not standalone threshold signal development
universePolicy: All instruments authentic in two preserved annual runs; broker expansion is not capped at twelve when extra source has a distinct justified premise. No data from unseen instruments invented.
ensemble: Causal online equal-prior exp(-matured normalized squared loss) weighting with fixed decay, zero-skill prior; no hindsight selection of best feature family
predictiveMethod: Per symbol/family/horizon online six-feature bounded squared-loss SGD, fixed learning rate and shrinkage; matured forward labels only; standardization from causally previous observed hourly volatility, no completed label from current or future horizon.

costs.source: original development synchronized BID/ASK and current broker contract details
sides: conservative observed current-term funding when overnight
costs.commission: current max of authentic cost contexts
costs.fundingMissing: mark unknown and disallow funded book exposure; never treat as zero
costs.executionPrices: M5 complete-bar bid-like price with modeled spread/latency; not genuine historical fills, not broker verified gross/cost NET
costs.noFutureCost: Frozen true development quote/commission/funding contexts only applied in selection and exposed audit financed decision clocks, never to an earlier capital decision

portfolio.volumeGrid: authentic current-minimum margin/notional from preserved synchronized source; 1-3 broker-minimum-sized units only when financed; no fixed historical 12-symbol ceiling
portfolio.positionConflict: at most one current position per instrument, but several different instruments simultaneously; held money/risk is shared
portfolio.marginalPolicy: same frozen forecast and calibration, replay FULL and 3 leave-one-family-out books from the same initial EUR200; difference is conditional marginal EUR not independent net edge
portfolio.economicExecution: Native C# scenario allocator with joint historical stress states and one common cash/positions replay model, no LIVE/DEMO order; C# LedgerEvent replay to check funded lifecycle where feasible
portfolio.portfolioAdmission: forecast net expected after adverse friction positive; no family required independently positive; native common selector may reject; no hard21 family quota
portfolio.hypotheticalFinancing: max of broker current minimum margin and adverse scenario sizing, 30 percent sampled-risk reference without lifetime risk qualification
portfolio.financedReplayStart: selection phase first eligible clock after the predeclared development cost calibration; no trades in development, continuous EUR200 through exposed audit; no later capital reset

calendar.exposure: ALL prior studies have exposed entire dataset. Audit is descriptive globally exposed, never independent confirmation.
calendar.boundary: No order opens if known clock+horizon crosses current phase; unknown observed future close is an unknown model outcome, never padded or dropped retroactively from forecasts.

prequentialSkill: normalized mean squared error vs zero drift and 4h momentum
Brier probability above zero vs neutral 0.5
information coefficient by phase and family
economicAmplitude: absolute prior horizon move distribution vs current conditional scenario cost
expected forecast bps and realized gross bps
per-trade modeled EUR at real current minimum volume
shared capital and margin utilization, peak and floating sampled drawdown
evaluation.qualification: None on globally exposed source; no historic fills, certified lifetime peak, complete execution or independent 12-month holdout.
evaluation.noPromotion: Selection cannot adapt thresholds after seeing results; scenario/portfolio adverse failures prohibit promotion; AUDIT may not choose favorable portfolio or substitute the best ablation.
